description: Activation for a 30-day plan, subscriber as fee payer: subscribe then transfer_subscription on the pinned program, first charge to the recipient's ATA, the merchant as puller. The SDK's build must pass the Rust server's activation verification and carry the same instruction multiset as the kit's build.

spec.quote: The subscriber-signed activation transaction MUST:

description: feePayer=true: the activation's fee payer is methodDetails.feePayerKey, whose signature slot the client leaves for the server.

spec.quote: set the fee payer to methodDetails.feePayerKey when methodDetails.feePayer is true, and to the subscriber otherwise;

description: externalId set: the activation may carry it as a memo instruction (memo is the one optional instruction besides compute budget).

spec.quote: The subscriber-signed activation transaction MUST:

description: A 2-week plan (336 period_hours): the subscribe instruction's expected period_hours is the mapped interval.

spec.quote: Servers MUST reject request objects where the mapped per-billing- period interval is zero or exceeds 8760 hours.

description: A Token-2022 mint: every token-touching instruction uses methodDetails.tokenProgram and the ATAs are derived under Token-2022.

spec.quote: use the SPL Token or Token-2022 program identified by methodDetails.tokenProgram for all token-touching instructions;

description: The challenge's puller is not the plan owner but is listed in plan.pullers, so it may collect: the client signs.

spec.quote: MUST be plan.owner or appear in plan.pullers |

description: A challenge carrying exactly the spec's fields (REQUIRED methodDetails plus network and recentBlockhash), with the plan on-chain: everything the activation needs is in the challenge or the plan, so the client builds it.

spec.quote: All payment methods implementing the "subscription" intent MUST support the required shared fields below.

description: feePayer=true without feePayerKey: the client cannot name the fee payer and must refuse the challenge.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: REQUIRED when feePayer is true |

description: methodDetails.subscriptionProgram names a program other than the subscriptions deployment the client trusts. The program would receive the subscriber's signature and token account; the client must refuse before signing.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Servers MUST pin its deployment address in methodDetails.subscriptionProgram, and clients MUST validate that address before signing.

description: currency names one mint and methodDetails.mint another: the wallet would display one token and sign a delegation over another.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Implementations MUST treat currency and methodDetails.mint as the same value; servers MUST reject request objects where they differ.

description: periodUnit=month: a client must not approximate a calendar month with a fixed interval.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Payment methods MUST reject request objects whose periodUnit or periodCount values they cannot represent exactly.

description: periodCount=366 days maps to 8784 hours, over the profile's 8760-hour limit.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Servers MUST reject request objects where the mapped per-billing- period interval is zero or exceeds 8760 hours.

description: amount="010000000" uses a leading zero; the client must refuse the request rather than read it as 10000000.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: The amount value MUST be a string representation of a positive integer in base 10 with no sign, decimal point, exponent, or surrounding whitespace.

description: amount="0" is not a positive integer, even against a plan whose amount is 0.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: The amount value MUST be a string representation of a positive integer in base 10 with no sign, decimal point, exponent, or surrounding whitespace.

description: periodCount="030" uses a leading zero.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: The periodCount value MUST be a string representation of a positive integer in base 10 with no sign, decimal point, exponent, or surrounding whitespace.

description: methodDetails.tokenProgram is the System program, neither SPL Token nor Token-2022.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: The value MUST be the SPL Token program or the SPL Token-2022 program |

description: methodDetails without planAddress, a REQUIRED field.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: | methodDetails.planAddress | string | REQUIRED | Base58 address of the on-chain Plan account |

description: methodDetails without puller, a REQUIRED field: the client cannot name the transfer_subscription signer.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: | methodDetails.puller | string | REQUIRED | Base58 of the server's puller pubkey.

description: methodDetails without decimals, a REQUIRED field (wallets render the per-period amount with it).

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: | methodDetails.decimals | number | REQUIRED | Decimal precision of the mint |

description: methodDetails.planAddress is not a base58 address.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: | methodDetails.planAddress | string | REQUIRED | Base58 address of the on-chain Plan account |

description: No account exists at methodDetails.planAddress: there is no on-chain Plan for the challenge to agree with.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Clients MUST NOT sign an activation transaction whose on-chain Plan does not match the challenge.

description: The on-chain Plan charges 5000000 per period; the challenge says 10000000.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Clients MUST NOT sign an activation transaction whose on-chain Plan does not match the challenge.

description: The on-chain Plan bills every 168 hours; the challenge says 30 days (720 hours).

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Clients MUST NOT sign an activation transaction whose on-chain Plan does not match the challenge.

description: The on-chain Plan is denominated in another mint than methodDetails.mint.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: MUST equal the on-chain plan.mint |

description: The challenge's puller is neither plan.owner nor in plan.pullers: the program would refuse every pull, so the activation could never charge.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: MUST be plan.owner or appear in plan.pullers |

description: The plan's destination whitelist is empty, so the program would let renewals pay any receiver.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Servers and clients MUST reject request objects referencing a plan with an empty destination whitelist, more than one non-zero destination, or a destination different from recipient.

description: The plan whitelists the recipient and a second address: renewals could be routed to the other one.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: Servers and clients MUST reject request objects referencing a plan with an empty destination whitelist, more than one non-zero destination, or a destination different from recipient.

description: The plan's only destination is not the challenge's recipient.

expect.rejectReason: the client must refuse to sign this challenge

spec.quote: The non-zero entries in plan.destinations MUST consist of exactly one address, and that address MUST equal recipient.
